entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, it's nothing but Japanese people[n]'round here.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I thought we were gonna be gettin' alohas[n]comin' from all directions and stuff!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It costs money to enjoy that atmosphere,[n]you know. There's not much we can do[n]as students.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I guess it's the same no matter where[n]we go...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey. What's with the low energy, Makoto?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I just had to listen to the taxi driver[n]complain for thirty minutes straight.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm used to dealing with students'[n]troubles, but I never expected to[n]have to do it overseas as well...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That must have sucked.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We should be doin' some more excitin'[n]stuff! I mean, we're in freakin' Hawaii,[n]for god's sake!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Isn't the school supposed to plan stuff?[n]I wanna go divin'!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It seems there wasn't enough time to[n]come up with any kind of coordinated[n]travel plan.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That lack of coordination is what led[n]them to using students as chaperones[n]as well.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: By the way, [fName]... you're roomin'[n]with Mishima, right? How is it? Anythin'[n]interestin'?
All Phan-Site, all the time.
He won't shut up.
Nothing really.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Even in Hawaii?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Really? Mishima-kun is the one who[n]made the Phan-Site, correct?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That's odd... I would've expected him to[n]at least talk to you about what's up with[n]the Phan-Site.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Phan-Site... Y'know, I do hear people[n]talkin' about the Phantom Thieves[n]every so often...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Are they really mentioning us?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I think so! We've already made our[n]international debut!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, just talkin' about that makes me[n]wanna go back to Japan so bad!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You really have no chill.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Come on, let's try and forget about[n]those things for now.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But people're waitin' for us to fix[n]society! We don't got time to be[n]relaxin' over here!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ain't that right, Yusu—

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait, what the hell!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Overseas travel provides a great[n]opportunity for new insight. I'd prefer[n]we stay here a bit longer.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What are you doing here!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Wasn't your school supposed to be[n]going to Los Angeles?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Apparently they couldn't land the plane[n]due to a terrible storm brewing on the[n]west coast.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: There were no signs of it letting up, so[n]our destination was changed on the spot[n]to Hawaii.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Do you just bring rain wherever you go!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Could it be that what happened at the[n]fireworks festival was his fault as well?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Don't go bringing any storms here,[n]you got that?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'll do my best.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: By the way, there's nothing planned after[n]this. What are you all going to do?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uh... Oh yeah, I still gotta buy souvenirs.[n]My mom asked me to grab some stuff[n]for her.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I totally forgot about that! We need[n]to pick things up for Futaba and[n]Morgana too.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I was hoping to do some shopping[n]myself.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Then it's settled. I wonder what Morgana[n]would want...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, our group's totally the same even[n]outta Japan...
